sinopsis.es: Desde pequeños, Ginger y Louie sabían que eran distintos. Dos jóvenes queer enfrentan, en los espacios que habitan, prejuicios sociales que intentan limitar su forma de ser. Deciden usar la moda y sus cuerpos para expresar y construir su identidad como un proceso fluido, libre y sin etiquetas.
sinopsis.en: Since they were little, Ginger and Louie knew they were different. In the spaces they inhabit, two young queer people face social prejudices that try to limit their way of being. They decide to use fashion and their bodies to express and build their identity as a fluid process, free and without labels.
